brief.en: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
brief.zh: 点击发射一颗爆炸性椰子炮弹

description.en: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
description.zh: 椰子加农炮沿着本行发射，炸裂时造成范围性伤害。

chat.en: Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
chat.zh: 当然他已经是个长发老人，但是椰子加农炮仍然能用各种枪管发射。他之所以这么多毛发，是因为他还在接受蜜蜡除毛服务。

text.en: on impact, explodes in medium area
text.zh: 击中目标时，在中等范围内爆炸
